headline: Vale Third-Quarter Profit Drops 53% to $1.26 Billion on Weaker Iron Ore
summary: Brazilian miner Vale reported a 53% year-on-year drop in third-quarter net profit to $1.26 billion as iron ore prices declined. Iron ore output fell 6% annually to 88.4 million tonnes, while copper and nickel generated one-third of company cash flow.
why: Vale is one of the world's largest iron ore and nickel producers. Its operational and earnings data serve as key indicators for global industrial commodities demand and Chinese steel consumption.

impacts.name: Vale S.A.
impacts.why: Lower realized prices for iron ore directly reduced net income and operating margins.
